PARAG BADJATE

CHARTERED ACCOUNTANT

8767289120 LinkedIn
Aug 2023 - Aug 2025
Mumbai
Jul 2026
Jul 2026
badjateparag@gmail.com
SUMMARY
Newly qualified Chartered Accountant, having cleared in first attempt and articleship experience in statutory audit across diverse
industries. Strong foundation in financial reporting, internal controls, analytical review and business process understanding.
EDUCATION

	Course	Year	Institution	Score	Remarks
	CA Final	May 2026	ICAI	321 / 600	Exemption in 2 Subjects.
(First Attempt)

	CA Intermediate	May 2023	ICAI	446 / 800	Exemption in 2 Subjects.
(First Attempt)

	CA Foundation	June 2022	ICAI	295 / 400	Passed with distinction.
(First Attempt)

	BBA	April 2022 -
April 2025	Savitribai Phule Pune University	GPA 8.43	Graduated with A+ Grade.
1st rank in BBA College.

	Class XII	March 2022	HSC Examination	90.17%	Scored 99 marks in Maths.
4th rank in city.

	Class X	March 2020	SSC Examination	92.40%	Scored 95 marks in Maths.
3rd rank in school.



WORK EXPERIENCE

Articled Assistant

Singhi & Co.

(Leading CA Firm (Ranked Top 10) with 40 Partners and 8 offices providing services for more than last 85 years in diverse areas.)
FMCG (Turnover > Rs. 1200 Crores)
	Supported statutory audit planning by assisting in scoping, allocating work across a team of 5 articled assistants, and
performing risk assessment procedures on key balances.

	Performed detailed testing of financial control which includes fixed assets, HR and payroll, finance and accounts.

	Contributed to the detection and reporting of employee fraud exceeding 1 crore in accordance with SA240 and section 143(12)
reporting requirements.

	Worked on first-time transition from IGAAP to IND AS with hands on exposure to IND AS 101 adjustments, reconciliations and
disclosure requirements.


Manufacturing - Chemicals (Turnover > Rs. 800 Crores)
	Handled compliance testing of statutory dues including TDS, TCS through challan mapping, reconciliation, and due date testing.

	Performed year end stock audit and physical inventory verification.


Manufacturing - Tyre Rubber (Turnover > Rs. 50 Crores)
	Executed opening balance verification procedures under SA 510 by validating prior year balances and carry-forward
adjustments.

	Led audit execution for key reporting areas such as revenue, inventory and assets including Test of Details and variance
analysis.


Restaurant Chain Busines (Turnover > Rs. 400 Crores)
	Conducted IFC and TOD for revenue realization during the year.

	Prepared analytical review schedules and area-wise detailed variance analyses for revenue, margins, and key expense heads.


Others
	Executed Internal Audit assignments for a subsidiary of a leading battery manufacturing company across P2P, R2R, HR
functions.

	Assisted in Transfer Pricing assignments for listed textile and apparel companies, including functional analysis, benchmarking,
and transfer pricing documentation.

	Gained audit and advisory exposure across NBFC, data centres, quick commerce, real estate, and manufacturing clients by
participating in end-to-end engagements.


EXTRA-CURRICULAR ACTIVITIES, ACHIEVEMENTS & CERTIFICATIONS

	Volunteer at Inner Wheel Club NPO in a tree plantation drive.

	Led a school Cricket Team in State Level Tournament fostering teamwork and on-field decision making.

	Participated in National CA Student Conferences and WICASA Chess competition reflecting strategic thinking skills.

	Elected as a School President of Students council in Class X.


SKILLS

Tools & Technologies: SAP, Tally Prime, MS -Excel, Word, PowerPoint, ERP System

CERTIFICATIONS

Finance Masterclass

(CAMonk)

Certified in AI for Finance

(CAMonk)


tel:8767289120
https://www.linkedin.com/in/parag-badjate-454460282?utm_source=share_via&utm_content=profile&utm_medium=member_ios
mailto:badjateparag@gmail.com
